# namespace_github_runner_profile (Resource)

Manages a Namespace Cloud GitHub Actions runner profile, configuring virtual instance compute specs, persistent cache attachments, image customizations, and egress network policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

resource "namespace_github_runner_profile" "high_perf_builder" {
  tag          = "ubuntu-24-04-large"
  os           = "ubuntu-24.04"
  description  = "High-performance build runner with persistent cache attachment"
  emoji        = "🚀"
  swap_size_mb = 2048

  builder_mode = "USE_REMOTE_BUILDER"
  access_level = "ACCESS_LEVEL_PERMISSIVE"

  experimental_features = [
    "nested-virtualization",
  ]

  instance_shape = {
    virtual_cpu      = 8
    memory_megabytes = 32768
    machine_arch     = "amd64"
    os               = "linux"
    selectors = [
      {
        name  = "purpose"
        value = "builder"
      }
    ]
  }

  cache_volume_settings = [
    {
      volume_tag                   = "build-cache"
      volume_size_gb               = 100
      volume_reserved_size_gb      = 10
      bundled_container_cache      = true
      bundled_buildkit_cache       = true
      bundled_git_mirror           = true
      bundled_runner_tools_cache   = true
      bundled_runner_actions_cache = true
      allow_commit_from_branch     = ["main", "release/*"]
    }
  ]

  custom_runner_image_spec = {
    ubuntu_spec = {
      apt_package = ["clang", "lld", "ninja-build"]
    }
    docker_spec = {
      dockerfile_content = "RUN curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh"
    }
  }

  network_policy = {
    egress = "EGRESS_POLICY_DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST"
    egress_domain_allow_list = [
      "github.com",
      "*.npmjs.org",
      "pypi.org",
    ]
    advisory = false
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `os` (String) Base image operating system label (e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`, `macos-15`).
- `tag` (String) Unique workspace alias for this runner profile, referenced in GitHub Actions `runs-on` labels.

### Optional

- `access_level` (String) Controls which Namespace features the runner workload can access (`ACCESS_LEVEL_UNSPECIFIED`, `ACCESS_LEVEL_PERMISSIVE`, `ACCESS_LEVEL_LIMITED`, `ACCESS_LEVEL_RESTRICTED`).
- `builder_mode` (String) Build execution caching mode (`BUILDER_MODE_UNSPECIFIED`, `USE_REMOTE_BUILDER`, `USE_LOCAL_CACHE`, `NO_CACHING`).
- `cache_volume_settings` (Attributes List) Persistent cache volume attachments for this runner profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cache_volume_settings))
- `custom_runner_image_spec` (Attributes) Custom runner image specification (Ubuntu APT packages and/or inline Dockerfile). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_runner_image_spec))
- `description` (String) Human-friendly description of the runner profile.
- `emoji` (String) Optional emoji visually identifying the profile in the Namespace UI.
- `experimental_features` (List of String) List of experimental feature flags enabled for this runner profile.
- `instance_shape` (Attributes) Instance compute shape configuration (CPU, memory, machine arch, OS). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_shape))
- `network_policy` (Attributes) Network egress policy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_policy))
- `swap_size_mb` (Number) Size of swap space to provision on the runner in megabytes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC3339Nano creation timestamp.
- `custom_runner_images` (Attributes List) List of custom runner image build statuses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_runner_images))
- `id` (String) Stable server-assigned identifier for this runner profile.
- `profile_id` (String) Stable runner profile ID.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339Nano last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Monotonic revision number used for optimistic concurrency locking during updates.

<a id="nestedatt--cache_volume_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cache_volume_settings`

Required:

- `volume_size_gb` (Number) Total size of the cache volume in gigabytes.
- `volume_tag` (String) Unique identifier for this cache volume within the profile.

Optional:

- `allow_commit_from_branch` (List of String) List of branch names allowed to write to this cache volume.
- `bundled_buildkit_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle BuildKit cache in this volume.
- `bundled_container_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle container image cache in this volume.
- `bundled_git_mirror` (Boolean) Whether to bundle git repository mirror in this volume.
- `bundled_runner_actions_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle GitHub Actions cache in this volume.
- `bundled_runner_tools_cache` (Boolean) Whether to bundle runner tool cache in this volume.
- `volume_reserved_size_gb` (Number) Reserved size that cannot be used by the cache, in gigabytes.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_runner_image_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_runner_image_spec`

Optional:

- `docker_spec` (Attributes) Dockerfile customizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_runner_image_spec--docker_spec))
- `ubuntu_spec` (Attributes) Ubuntu APT package customizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_runner_image_spec--ubuntu_spec))

<a id="nestedatt--custom_runner_image_spec--docker_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_runner_image_spec.docker_spec`

Required:

- `dockerfile_content` (String) Dockerfile content to execute as an image layer on top of base image.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_runner_image_spec--ubuntu_spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_runner_image_spec.ubuntu_spec`

Required:

- `apt_package` (List of String) List of Ubuntu APT package names to install.



<a id="nestedatt--instance_shape"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_shape`

Optional:

- `machine_arch` (String) Architecture of the instance (`amd64`, `arm64`).
- `memory_megabytes` (Number) Memory in megabytes.
- `os` (String) Compute OS family (`linux`, `macos`).
- `selectors` (Attributes List) Node label selectors for instance placement. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instance_shape--selectors))
- `virtual_cpu` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.

<a id="nestedatt--instance_shape--selectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instance_shape.selectors`

Required:

- `name` (String) Selector key name.
- `value` (String) Selector value.



<a id="nestedatt--network_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_policy`

Required:

- `egress` (String) Egress policy mode (`EGRESS_POLICY_UNKNOWN`, `EGRESS_POLICY_NONE`, `EGRESS_POLICY_DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST`, `EGRESS_POLICY_TAG`).

Optional:

- `advisory` (Boolean) When true, runs egress domain allowlist in advisory mode (log only, not blocked).
- `egress_domain_allow_list` (List of String) List of allowed domain names when egress mode is `EGRESS_POLICY_DOMAIN_ALLOW_LIST`.
- `egress_policy_tag` (String) Workspace policy tag to apply when egress mode is `EGRESS_POLICY_TAG`.


<a id="nestedatt--custom_runner_images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom_runner_images`

Read-Only:

- `build_ref` (String) Build reference identifier.
- `built_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when image build completed.
- `image_ref` (String) Registry image reference.
- `last_build_error` (String) Last image build error message if build failed.
- `last_error_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of last build failure.
- `started_build_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when image build started.
- `status` (String) Image build status (`STATUS_UNKNOWN`, `BUILDING`, `READY`, `FAILED`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the stable Namespace profile ID. A unique profile tag is also accepted.
terraform import namespace_github_runner_profile.high_perf_builder prof_0123456789abcdef
```
